description: How members, employer buyers, program administrators, and contributors relate to each other: who sponsors and activates the benefit, who delivers support to whom, and which privacy-preserving feedback loops prove value.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Sponsoring the benefit and booking facilitators and events

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Rolling out programs, delivering sessions, and supporting members day to day

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Needs signals, anonymized engagement data, and outcome reporting

relations.name: Sponsors member access
relations.description: Funds the wellbeing benefit through a per-employee subscription so members access the community, content, and sessions at no personal cost.

relations.name: Delegates program rollout
relations.description: Hands the purchased benefit to the HR program administrator to launch, with eligibility rules, budget, and success expectations set at buying time.

relations.name: Activates and engages employees
relations.description: Runs launch communications, campaigns, and internal events that turn eligible employees into active members and keep the habit alive past the launch spike.

relations.name: Delivers support content and live sessions
relations.description: Publishes vetted content, answers member questions, and hosts live sessions so members find timely, relatable support for the challenge in front of them.

relations.name: Signals needs and topics
relations.description: Raises questions, reactions, and discussion themes in the community that tell contributors which topics to cover next and which formats actually land.

relations.name: Books facilitators for custom events
relations.description: Commissions vetted facilitators and speakers for employer-specific live events and campaign moments, matched and scheduled through the platform.

relations.name: Feeds anonymized engagement signals
relations.description: Contributes only aggregated, anonymized participation and topic signals to program reporting, keeping individual activity invisible to the employer by design.

relations.name: Reports adoption and outcomes
relations.description: Rolls up activation, engagement, and outcome evidence into the value story the benefits leader needs at renewal time.
